---
title: Sauté of Clams
id: MAR-0012
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 11
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 1 kg clams, purged
- 2 garlic cloves
- 10 g parsley
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste black pepper
## Method
1. Pour the oil into a saucepan and add the peeled garlic.
2. Cook the clams in a covered saucepan for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they have opened.
3. Drain them, discarding any that remain closed, and strain the liquid that has formed.
4. Put the clams in a bowl with the parsley, pour the cooking liquid over them, season with a generous grinding of pepper and serve.
